topic: change strings on an acoustic or electric guitar
core_question: How do I replace old guitar strings with new ones? (secondary: How do I tune a drum head so the pitch is even all the way around?)
answer_summary: Loosen and remove the old strings, thread each new string through the bridge/tuning post, wind it while keeping tension, cut excess, then tune up to pitch and stretch/retune a few times.; after the topic shift: Turn each tension rod a small, equal amount at a time in a star or crisscross sequence around the rim, checking pitch at each lug, so tension stays even across the head.
persona: friendly but persistent; using casual slang
